faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Market Research

items.question: What is competitor research and why do you need it?
items.answer: Competitor research analyses the strategies, strengths and weaknesses of your competitors. It helps you identify your competitive advantage, position yourself correctly in the market and make well-founded decisions.

items.question: How long does a market research project take?
items.answer: Depending on scope, market research takes 1-4 weeks. We deliver a detailed report with statistics, charts and strategic recommendations for your business.

items.question: What does consumer research include?
items.answer: Consumer research includes surveys, purchase-behaviour analysis and preference evaluation. You use real data to adapt your products and services to what your audience actually needs.

items.question: Which businesses do you work with?
items.answer: We serve SMEs and local or regional businesses across Epirus and Greece that want evidence-based growth decisions. We specialise in the Greek market.

items.question: What is the difference between market analysis and SWOT analysis?
items.answer: Market analysis maps the overall environment — competition, trends, audience. SWOT analysis evaluates the business itself: strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats. We provide both.
